en: Oh, I'm some rich affluent person.
zh: 哦，我是个有钱的富裕人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to take this person off the streets.
zh: 我要把这个人从街头带走。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to do whatever.
zh: 我要怎样怎样。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the Pygmalion effect was more of a psychological effect.
zh: 但皮格马利翁效应更多是一种心理学效应。

speaker: Unknown
en: They did a study.
zh: 他们做过一项研究。

speaker: Unknown
en: On self-fulfilling prophecy, I remember this when I was at Fordham doing, as a psychology undergraduate, the Pygmalion effect in this context, not the movie or a play, but inspired by it, is the expectation of the person can determine their own belief in themselves.
zh: 关于自我实现的预言，我记得这个，当时我在福德汉姆大学读心理学本科——在这个语境下的皮格马利翁效应，不是那部电影或那出戏，而是受它启发，指的是对一个人的期望可以决定他对自己本身的信念。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let that sink in for a moment.
zh: 让这个道理沉淀一会儿。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if society expects this person to succeed, and maybe people in the industry expect them to succeed, hey, maybe they will.
zh: 所以如果社会期望这个人成功，也许行业内的人也期望他成功，嘿，也许他真的会。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe they'll say, you know what, if people think I can do this, well, F yeah, maybe I can.
zh: 也许他会说，你猜怎么着，如果别人觉得我能做到，那，管他的，也许我真的能。

speaker: Unknown
en: I say, I think you can do it.
zh: 我说，我觉得你能做到。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's never been easier to be a startup founder.
zh: 当一个初创公司创始人从来没有像现在这么容易过。

speaker: Unknown
en: But let's also be realistic.
zh: 但我们也要现实一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm very concerned about the safety on the street of, you know, individuals who are homeless and the circumstance under which he got to be homeless.
zh: 我非常关心街上的安全问题，你知道，那些无家可归的人，以及他沦落到无家可归的处境。

speaker: Unknown
en: Could be no fault of his home.
zh: 可能完全不是他自己的错。

speaker: Unknown
en: Could be his own fault.
zh: 可能是他自己的错。

speaker: Unknown
en: Could be anything in between.
zh: 也可能介于两者之间的任何情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm rooting for this person.
zh: 我在为这个人加油。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I hope that this feedback gives them some hope and continues for them to drive.
zh: 我希望这条反馈能给他们一些希望，并继续推动他们前进。

speaker: Unknown
en: Don't worry about venture capitalists right now.
zh: 现在不用担心风险投资人。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're not going to fund you if you're homeless.
zh: 如果你无家可归，他们是不会给你投资的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You may get like a condescending thing here where somebody is like, oh, I would like to be the angel investor or seed investor who took them from homeless to a Y Combinator to a billionaire.
zh: 你可能会遇到一种居高临下的情形，有人说，哦，我很想成为那个天使投资人或种子投资人，带他从无家可归走到 Y Combinator 再变成亿万富翁。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't want to get into that because I think that's condescending and not realistic long.
zh: 我不想谈那个，因为我觉得那是居高临下，而且从长远来看不现实。

speaker: Unknown
en: A person who is on the street, the number one thing is safety, a job and food and clothing and healthcare.
zh: 一个流落街头的人，第一要紧的是安全、一份工作、食物、衣服和医疗。

speaker: Unknown
en: Go get the Walmart job, do that for a year, get yourself a little place, get yourself stable off the street.
zh: 去找份沃尔玛的工作，干上一年，给自己找个小住处，让自己稳定下来，离开街头。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's when you start thinking about, oh, okay, now it's time for me to start getting my startup together.
zh: 那时候你才开始想，哦，好了，现在是我开始把我的初创公司弄起来的时候了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I couldn't agree more.
zh: 我完全同意。

speaker: Unknown
en: The attitude is what impressed me, that this is a homeless person.
zh: 让我印象深刻的是那种态度，这个人是个无家可归的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're not asking for a handout.
zh: 他们没有伸手要施舍。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not self-pitying.
zh: 没有自怜自艾。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're not giving us a woe is me story.
zh: 他们没有给我们讲“我好惨”的故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: He goes right in to like, and I've got two startup ideas.
zh: 他直接就进入正题，比如，我有两个初创公司的点子。

speaker: Unknown
en: I need people to hear that.
zh: 我需要人们听到这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: Two, not one, two.
zh: 两个，不是一个，是两个。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's the speed at which we go from, hey, I'm living on the street, by the way, here's my companies.
zh: 就是那种速度，从“嘿，我住在街上”，顺便说一句，“这是我的公司”。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was impressed.
zh: 我被打动了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, let me ask you this.
zh: 那么，让我问问你。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you were at the homeless shelter around the corner from the offices, did you run into this individual when they identified you as homeless?
zh: 当你在办公室附近拐角处的流浪汉收容所时，当他们认出你是无家可归者的时候，你遇到过这个人吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I did not.
zh: 我没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that has not happened in over a year.
zh: 而且那已经是一年多以前的事了。

speaker: Unknown
en: The greatest story ever.
zh: 这是有史以来最棒的故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Over a year.
zh: 一年多。

speaker: Unknown
en: This guy looks like he could be a startup founder.
zh: 这家伙看起来就像一个初创公司创始人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Lon was walking to his car.
zh: 当时 Lon 正走向他的车。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's got a nice car.
zh: 他有辆不错的车。

speaker: Unknown
en: I pay him a decent salary here.
zh: 我在这里给他发了挺不错的薪水。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's got a decent car.
zh: 他有辆还不错的车。

speaker: Unknown
en: Going to his nice house, got a house now.
zh: 要回他漂亮的房子，现在有房子了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Dog, he's doing great.
zh: 养着狗，他过得很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: He walks by the homeless shelter.
zh: 他路过那个流浪汉收容所。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Guy says, well, there's a line because in the morning- Come on in.
zh: 有个人说，呃，那儿排着队呢，因为早上的—— 快进来吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: We can help you any way you want.
zh: 我们可以在任何方面帮你。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's going, you went full hobo style.
zh: 他说，你整得跟个流浪汉一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's why I suited you up.
zh: 所以我才给你穿上了正装。

speaker: Unknown
en: He made a place for me.
zh: 他给我占了个位置。

speaker: Unknown
en: He was making a place for me in line.
zh: 他正在队伍里给我占位置。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's like, hey, come, you can come sit right here.
zh: 他说，嘿，来，你可以坐这儿。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, actually, I'm on my way to my job.
zh: 我说，实际上，我正赶去上班呢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you very much.
zh: 非常感谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's okay.
zh: 没关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: Actually, it's okay.
zh: 其实，挺好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I am not a hobo.
zh: 我不是流浪汉。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a little bit of a wake up call, folks, when the homeless.
zh: 各位，当无家可归的人出现时，这算是有点警钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: You gotta admire my love of comedy that I immediately came in and told that story.
zh: 你们得佩服我对喜剧的热爱，我马上进来就讲了那个故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: A lot of people would die, take that to their graves.
zh: 很多人会宁可死也不说，把那件事带进坟墓。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not me, I couldn't wait to get on camera and tell that story.
zh: 我不是，我迫不及待想上镜头讲那个故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: People think Lon, you know, they see Lon on with his custom suit and shirts.
zh: 我把它叫做 Lon 的流浪汉风格，或者当他在……

speaker: Unknown
en: He's manicured well, but imagine him if he's wearing like a t-shirt from the eighties he's had for 30 years and he's wearing a pair of stained jeans that you could make this mistake.
zh: 他打理得很体面，但想象一下他如果穿着一件有 30 年历史的八十年代 T 恤，穿着一条沾了污渍的牛仔裤，你可能会犯这个错误。

speaker: Unknown
en: He could be hobo.
zh: 他可能是流浪汉。

speaker: Unknown
en: I call it when Lon's in hobo style or when he's in...
zh: 我把它叫作 Lon 的流浪汉风格,或者当他在……

speaker: Unknown
en: Who's the guy in Homeland with the big beard like you?
zh: 在 Homeland 里那个留大胡子的家伙是谁？就像你一样？

speaker: Unknown
en: Mandy Patinkin, Mandy Patinkin.
zh: Mandy Patinkin，Mandy Patinkin。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you're in your best look is Mandy Patinkin, you put hobo style, beard, crazy hair.
zh: 当你处于最佳造型时就是 Mandy Patinkin，你摆出流浪汉风格，胡子、疯狂的头发。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's got the big beard, but yeah, he slicks the hair back, Mandy Patinkin.
zh: 他有大胡子，不过是的，他把头发往后梳，Mandy Patinkin。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what I told you to do.
zh: 我就是这么跟你说的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have to Mandy Patankham this.
zh: 你得来点 Mandy Patinkham 风格。

speaker: Unknown
en: You've got to get a little hair gel going because the beard with the hair gel in the suit, you look exactly like Mandy Patankham.
zh: 你得抹点发胶，因为有胡子和发胶再配上西装，你看起来就跟 Mandy Patinkham 一模一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he's got good looking back.
zh: 而且他长得好看。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here it is.
zh: 在这儿。

speaker: Unknown
en: There he is from Homeland.
zh: 这是他在 Homeland 里的样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: Look at this.
zh: 看看这个。

en: I need to get a picture of Lon and him side by side.
zh: 我需要一张 Lon 和他并排的照片。

speaker: Unknown
en: And look- He could be my dad.
zh: 还有看——他可以是我爸爸。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's on the GLP.
zh: 他在用 GLP。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, he looks a lot like- And he's on the GLP-1.
zh: 是啊，他看起来很像——而且他在用 GLP-1。

en: Of course.
zh: 当然。

en: Look how skinny he is.
zh: 看看他多瘦。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course he is, yeah.
zh: 他当然是，是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Look at that.
zh: 看那个。

speaker: Unknown
en: That looks like you.
zh: 那看起来像你。

speaker: Unknown
en: We should get you a pair of readers.
zh: 我们应该给你配一副老花镜。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll bring in a picture of Lee Harris, my dad.
zh: 我会带一张 Lee Harris 的照片来，我爸爸。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a very strong likeness.
zh: 非常像。

speaker: Unknown
en: He could definitely be my father.
zh: 他绝对可以当我父亲。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it's a good look for you, but the slick back.
zh: 我觉得这造型挺适合你，不过要往后梳。

speaker: Unknown
en: See, there is a slick back.
zh: 看，确实有往后梳。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a slick back.
zh: 有往后梳。

en: Look at him in the tie.
zh: 看他系领带的样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm putting you in a tie on the show next week.
zh: 下周我要让你在节目里系领带。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to have a tie week for you.
zh: 我要给你搞一个领带周。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want to see.
zh: 我想看看。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll put my tie on too.
zh: 我也会系上我的领带。

speaker: Unknown
en: All right.
zh: 好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you for the question.
zh: 感谢你的提问。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好。

en: Great job, everybody.
zh: 大家干得不错。

en: Bye.
